question: The first edition of Indian Women's Premier League (cricket) was held in the year

• The** first edition of the Indian Women's Premier League (WPL) was held in March 202**3.

• The **first edition of the Men Indian Premier League (IPL) cricket tournament was held in the year **2008.
 
• **The IPL is a professional Twenty20 cricket league in India, founded by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).**
 
• **The league has gained immense popularity and has become one of the most-watched cricket leagues in the world.**
 
• **The inaugural season of the IPL featured eight team**s representing different cities in India.
